lavafall-west-left-water-ground.referencePolicy: Narrow flowing lava ribbon immediately right of the faceted left wall. Earlier conservative unknown envelope covered this water as well. Rock reflection and curtain/rock antialiasing remain unknown.

run3-ice-east-water-ground.referencePolicy: Open flowing cyan water bounded by the far cliff toes and foreground spires. Trace is inset on the water side. Snow-capped silhouettes, foliage and narrow uncertain antialiased edges remain unknown.

run3-ice-mouth-water-ground.referencePolicy: Only the cyan flowing water above the near leaves and around the isolated boulder. Purple receiving river is not labelled as ice stream. Leaf tips, cliff, boulder and bank antialiasing remain unknown.

run3-lava-upper-left-curtain-ground.referencePolicy: Falling curtain and narrow right flowing ribbon traced from the smooth vertical strands. Receiving water is separate from the foreground rough rock rim; uncertain glowing cliff stays unknown.

run3-lava-mouth-curtain-ground.referencePolicy: Smooth continuous lava strands in the centre-right curtain and white/orange receiving foam. The faceted right cliff is excluded; no red-colour classifier or production mask was consulted for these contours.

run4-upper-left-flowing-ribbons.referencePolicy: Thin left flowing strands and bright receiving-water foam; exclude the faceted side wall and foreground dark rock rim. Inset water-side contours, not the orange glow on rock.

run4-mouth-receiving-foam.referencePolicy: Continuous bright receiving-water foam across the base of the curtain. Right faceted cliff and glowing cracks remain unknown. This observation does not classify the face as flat lava for particles.

run4-volcano-left-ribbon.referencePolicy: Only the unambiguous bright receiving-water toe is labelled. Left edge and dark centre-right face stay unknown after ground-only preview; the initial narrow-ribbon interpretation was rejected before measurement.
run4-volcano-left-ribbon.preMeasurementRevision: Discarded left ribbon and foreground-rock-edge polygons after enlarged ground preview; retained only the bright receiving-water toe.

run4-ice-central-right-pool.referencePolicy: Two visible pools around the central spires, bounded on the water side of cliff silhouettes. The cyan-lit cliff faces above the oval pool are excluded, as are the foreground spire and gold leaves.

run4-lava-middle-upper-pool.referencePolicy: Upper open horizontal pool between the cliff toes, ending before the foreground trees and the pointed rock island. The orange-lit vertical cliff above y60 remains outside.

run4-lava-west-upper-pool.referencePolicy: Open flat pool above the lip of west fall. Stop at the horizontal lip before the vertical curtain; inset both rock banks and the pointed foreground rock.

run4-lava-west-right-bend.referencePolicy: Clear level river bend between the central rock island and the right foreground spire. Exclude the dry peninsula, red foliage and the mist on the left.
run4-lava-west-right-bend.preMeasurementRevision: Enlarged ground review showed the first contour crossed the foreground spire and red leaf fringe. Inset to the clear-water interior before any measurement; keep the bank gap unknown.

run4-ice-upper-receiving-pool.referencePolicy: Clear receiving pool around the central boulder and the blue water above the foreground spires. Small rocks are independently excluded by the hard-surface observation. The blue columns against the back wall remain unknown.

run4-lava-middle-bank-water.referencePolicy: Horizontal lava water-side of the upper-right cliff toe and in the clear inlet before red foliage. The orange-lit wall and leaf silhouettes remain outside these inset observations.

run4-ice-lower-receiving-pools.referencePolicy: Visible level receiving water between the lower cascades and the outlet pool. Inset the foreground flowers, bridge and faceted right bank. Spray against a rock face and water hidden by leaves stay unknown. No falling faces are classified as flat in this observation.

run4-lava-west-main-pool.referencePolicy: Clear horizontal pool behind the foreground spire. Follow an inset of the right spire silhouette and exclude the smaller near spire. The left mist and unknown glowing sidewall remain unlabelled. This replaces no source observation; union only.

preMeasurementReview: Removed rock silhouettes, foreground peaks, tree canopies and mouth boulder from the new label patches after comparing ground and label-only previews. Broad river lower edge is retained as unknown. No production alpha used for these revisions. Native east-channel label preview showed uncertain bright rock-edge reflections on the foreground spires. Their complete conservative silhouettes were returned to unknown in both old and new observations. Central retaining-wall lip also remains unknown.
